pages.text: Cold hurts in stages. Heat and depth stop it.$(br2)$(flavor)Hypothermia is not a personality trait. It is a medical emergency. A slow one.$()

pages.title: Stages
pages.text: $(bold)0°C and up$(): fine$(br)$(bold)0 to -10°C$(): chilly, harmless$(br2)$(bold)-10°C$(): Slowness I, warning only$(br)$(bold)-25°C$(): Slowness II, $(danger)1 heart/2 s$()$(br)$(bold)-45°C$(): Slowness III, $(danger)2 hearts/2 s$()$(br)$(bold)-70°C$(): Slowness IV, $(danger)3 hearts/2 s$()
$(flavor)Stage names, per ORSA Wellness: "It's Fine", "Oh No", "Critical" and "Goodbye". There is no Stage 5. Stage 5 is a respawn screen.$()

pages.title: Wind Chill
pages.text: From Phase 5, wind drains hunger above Y=50 under open sky: most while sprinting, least standing still.$(br2)Underground is safe.

pages.title: Suffocation
pages.text: In late Phase 6 the surface is vacuum. $(danger)Without air you suffocate$(): darkness, nausea, slowness, fading vision, death.
You need a sealed room with trapped air, or one fed by a Core or Blast Pit.$(br2)A roof alone traps nothing.
